summary: record robot data, rosbag, log topics, save sensor data, capture telemetry for debugging or experiment
description: Records selected robot topics or all common telemetry to a bag file. Command format: 'rosbag_record <name> <duration_s>' where name identifies the recording and duration_s bounds recording time. Output reports file path, topics, bytes written, dropped messages, and completion. Report the saved bag path and recording health.
